items.question: Who is Zmind for?
items.answer: Zmind is designed for anyone who thinks deeply and creates—from students and researchers analyzing complex materials, to content creators and designers organizing inspiration, to teams collaborating on projects. Whether you're writing, studying, planning, or building, Zmind adapts to your workflow.

items.question: What file types can I import into Zmind?
items.answer: You can drop any type of content onto your Zmind canvas: documents (PDFs, Word files, Markdown, HTML), images, videos, audio files, web links, and plain text. Our AI automatically processes and organizes multimodal content, making everything searchable and connected.

items.question: How does AI "deep thinking" work in Zmind?
items.answer: Our AI doesn't just answer questions—it helps you think through problems. It can break down complex articles, generate structured outlines from messy notes, suggest connections between ideas, create visual diagrams from text, and guide you through analytical frameworks for research or decision-making.

items.question: Can I use Zmind for research and academic work?
items.answer: Absolutely. Zmind excels at research workflows: upload multiple papers or articles, and our AI helps you extract key insights, compare arguments, build literature maps, and generate citations. Perfect for literature reviews, thesis writing, or any deep analytical work.

items.question: How does collaboration work in Zmind?
items.answer: Every workspace in Zmind can be shared with team members or collaborators. You can work together in real-time on the same infinite canvas, leave comments, assign tasks, and track changes—whether you're working on a design project, presentation, or strategic plan.

items.question: Can Zmind generate images and videos?
items.answer: Yes! Zmind includes AI-powered media generation capabilities. You can create custom images, diagrams, and even videos directly within your workspace to support your ideas—perfect for design projects, presentations, or visual storytelling.

items.question: How is Zmind different from note-taking apps like Notion or Obsidian?
items.answer: Unlike traditional note-taking tools, Zmind gives you an infinite spatial canvas where ideas can be arranged freely, not just in pages or folders. Our AI is deeply integrated to help structure your thinking process, not just store information. Plus, we handle all media types natively—text, images, videos, and audio—in one unified workspace.

items.question: Is my data secure and private in Zmind?
items.answer: Your privacy is our priority. All your content is encrypted, and you maintain full control over what you share. Workspaces are private by default, and you decide exactly who can access your shared spaces.

header.title: Zmind: Visual AI Thinking Canvas
header.subtitle: Let AI agents and a multimodal canvas help you see, structure, and refine ideas

intro.overviewP1: Zmind is a full-modality AI learning and thinking assistant. It pairs an AI-native infinite canvas with guided agents so you can see your context, shape it visually, and keep the whole reasoning chain editable.

meet.title: Why it helps you think
meet.p1: We remove the biggest blocker in using AI for real thinking: unclear intent and messy context.
meet.li1: Guided questioning that reveals what you actually need and the assumptions behind it
meet.li2: Visual context so relationships and decisions never disappear in a chat log
meet.li3: Multimodal inputs (text, images, docs) that stay linked on one canvas graph
meet.li4: Agents that summarize, prune noise, and extend branches without losing the thread
meet.li5: Everything remains editable and collaborative instead of one-off replies
meet.p2: Intelligence^2 = Human Intelligence x Artificial Intelligence — with you in control.

build.title: What you can do
build.p: Built for people who must turn fuzzy problems into clear plans:
build.li1: Map complex decisions and explore branches with AI nudges, not walls of text
build.li2: Study and synthesize across docs, images, and links in one structured canvas
build.li3: Run workshops, meetings, and research with shared context and reusable outputs

how.title: How it works on the canvas
how.p: A single canvas where AI edits the same structure you see:
how.li1: Canvas JSON model shared by humans and agents — no hidden layers
how.li2: Guided prompts that clarify goals, risks, next steps, and missing info
how.li3: Multimodal understanding and generation with upcoming clipping integrations
how.li4: Reusable nodes and templates to speed up future sessions

why.title: What you experience
why.p: A workspace built for thinking, not just chatting:
why.li1: See and steer: visual branches, priorities, and decisions stay in view
why.li2: Edit everything: AI outputs are nodes you can reshape, link, and reuse
why.li3: Work together: share canvases, co-edit with teammates, and keep context persistent
